motions.headline: Rec center funding pulled, $1M pooled for parks
motions.summary: The council reworked how proceeds from the utility sale are spent, moving $2.6 million earmarked for a recreation center into unallocated funds and pooling $1 million for parks.
motions.impact: A recreation center is off the funding list for now — council members said it could be revisited later, possibly starting with buying land. The $1 million park fund still covers Silver Lake amphitheater, bike park, and Nolan Park improvements.

motions.headline: Public comment set on new school district
motions.summary: The council formally accepted a feasibility study on creating a new school district and scheduled public comment for June 13 and June 18, 2024, ahead of a final decision.
motions.impact: If you have kids in school or pay property taxes here, those two dates are your chance to weigh in before the council decides whether to create the district.
